fields.name: atY

fields.name: atZ

revisions.note: Where the end lies on walkable ground, a client takes the ground's height there for endY. Where age is not zero, it moves the missile's trail on by age seconds.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the missile is, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: Where the missile is, in height, in world units.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where the missile is, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: casterAtX
fields.note: Where the unit that threw it stood when it left, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: casterAtY
fields.note: Where the unit that threw it stood when it left, in height, in world units.

fields.name: casterAtZ
fields.note: Where the unit that threw it stood when it left, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: facingX
fields.note: Which way the missile points, along one ground axis.

fields.name: facingY
fields.note: Which way the missile points, in height.

fields.name: facingZ
fields.note: Which way the missile points, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: velocityX
fields.note: How fast the missile travels, along one ground axis, in world units a second.

fields.name: velocityY
fields.note: How fast the missile travels, in height, in world units a second.

fields.name: velocityZ
fields.note: How fast the missile travels, along the other ground axis, in world units a second.

fields.name: startX
fields.note: Where the missile began, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: startY
fields.note: Where the missile began, in height, in world units.

fields.name: startZ
fields.note: Where the missile began, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: endX
fields.note: Where the missile is bound for, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: endY
fields.note: Where the missile is bound for, in height, in world units.

fields.name: endZ
fields.note: Where the missile is bound for, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: unitAtX
fields.note: Where to place the casting unit, along one ground axis, in world units, unless the casting itself places it.

fields.name: unitAtY
fields.note: Its height, in world units.

fields.name: unitAtZ
fields.note: Where to place the casting unit, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: age
fields.note: How long the missile has existed, in seconds.

fields.name: speed
fields.note: How fast the missile travels, in world units a second.

fields.name: lifeSpent
fields.note: How much of its life is gone, as a part of one.

fields.name: speedChange
fields.note: What is added to that speed over the time below, in world units a second.

fields.name: speedChangeTime
fields.note: When the speed changes, in seconds from when the client creates the missile: once that much time has passed, a client adds the change to the speed, once. Where the speed never changes, a server sends the largest finite float, 340282346638528859811704183484516925440; zero or less takes effect at once.

bits.name: bounced
bits.note: Set where the missile has bounced. It applies only where age is above zero: a client then moves the missile to its position and places it again from the caster's position, the end and the facing.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.
